principle: Demotion is mechanical and pre-committed. A live strategy is demoted the moment any trigger fires; no discretion, no 'keep watching it'. Paper is the default state and live is the exception.

live_requirements.note: A strategy may not be live on fewer than 300 priced bets, however good it looks.

demotion_rules.rationale: The signal stopped beating the close; the staking result is irrelevant.

demotion_rules.trigger: Trailing 100-bet ROI lower bootstrap bound < 0 while the signal CLV bound is also < 0
demotion_rules.rationale: Both columns negative: neither luck nor skill explains the run.

demotion_rules.trigger: Any single bet exceeding the pre-committed max stake (2 units)
demotion_rules.action: DEMOTE to paper and void the offending bet
demotion_rules.rationale: Staking discipline is a gate, not a preference.

demotion_rules.trigger: Point-in-time integrity broken (an input later shown to be leaked, restated, or unavailable before kickoff)
demotion_rules.action: DEMOTE to paper and re-run from the corrected data
demotion_rules.rationale: A leaked feature can manufacture any result.

demotion_rules.trigger: The family of strategies grows by 50% or more (new variants added) without a matching rise in the significance bar
demotion_rules.action: DEMOTE every member of the family to paper until BH/Bonferroni are recomputed
demotion_rules.rationale: Trying more variants raises the chance that one looks good by luck.

demotion_rules.trigger: No settled bet for 21 days during the season, or the feed stops carrying prices for the market
demotion_rules.action: DEMOTE to paper; status becomes STALE, not live
demotion_rules.rationale: An unmeasurable strategy cannot be a live one.

promotion_rules.requirement: 300 priced bets, all 10 gates, CLV lower bound > 0
promotion_rules.action: PAPER -> LIVE with a 1-unit cap for the first 100 bets

promotion_rules.requirement: A further 100 bets with CLV lower bound > 0 at the 1-unit cap
promotion_rules.action: cap rises to 2 units; any DM trigger resets to paper

transitions.when: prices return and a bet settles

state_machine.note: A strategy can only move one step at a time and only by a computed trigger.

current_state.note: Nothing is live, so no demotion can have fired. The rules above are what make the next live strategy demotable without a judgement call.

position_sizing.note: A strategy with a CLV lower bound above zero earns more than 1 unit only while the bound stays above zero; the demotion rule removes it the moment it does not.
